notes.title: Sunwave Hotel - April Progress Report 1
notes.content:
Hello, one and all! Pull up your surfboard for a minute and let me talk at you about everything coming up from the waters of SH's development.

[list]
[*] I am very happy to announce that all of the animations for Corsoni's new mega scene are complete. 

[*] There is also going to be Bonus Corsoni Pregnant scene. This one will be unlocked after Corsoni is impregnated.

[*] Perluun Scene - I was crunching the numbers and of our main cast, Perluun is falling a bit behind her scenes, the sexy moon-elf deserves better. I have drafted out a new scene that will put her in the spotlight with a little sexy handplay right before one of her shows.

[*] Jade the Foxgirl - This lovely foxgirl lass will be making her return, and she'll also take part in a special scene that Xun and Kuhno are invited to.

[*] First Ending - It's still a bit strange, but I have actually written out the draft for one of the endings. It is a branch that will finish Xun's adventure, but without giving too much away, I would say it doesn't lead to the main ending that I have planned. Still, it will be part of a choice that players can make depending on how they are roleplaying.

[/list]

And that is just about everything that comes to mind. I'm excited for a new week, and I wish you all the best.

Be seeing you.

notes.title: Sunwave Hotel v14.12
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

It's strange I thought I made a post when I was uploading the new build but I guess not.

Hey just here to say that the game has been updated again with another small bug fix to patch some more of the rough spots. Keep those bug reports coming. I'm always looking to improve and polish up the game.

[u]Specifics[/u]
The Back Button during scenes should now be fully functional now. We're also looking into adding a regular Back Button for during conversations.
Improved Adoka Conversation. This is when you're talking to her and getting to know her better.
Day Counter is now in the Status Menu, not just on the screen.

[u]Future Fixes[/u]
Dedicated Back Button
Graphic Scaling - Apparently, this is an issue for some users.
Fixing Mac Save Bug - There is a Mac build for the game but we haven't been able to fix a save bug issue.
Saving during conversations
Journal and Codex. Something to keep track of your progress on the Main Quest, and something to give players more lore for the species and world of Sunwave Hotel.
Fix issues with Kuhno Conversation in the Guest House.
Improve dialogue for your first meeting with Kaci to clarify what she is talking about and ensure it's easy to get to her scene or skip it if you don't like it.

notes.title: Watch your back out there
notes.content:
[b]Hello Outlaws[/b]

This week has been a whirlwind. I've been delighted to meet many of you who picked up Sunwave Hotel and gave me some feedback. We've already got our first bugfix update out, hopefully further improving the game while we're still in the first month of Early Access.

As a special treat, I wanted to show off a trio of lovely ladies who will have an impact on the next big update to the story of Sunwave Hotel.

From left to right, we have Keylan, Badyrii, and Firah. I'm really happy with how their designs came out, and I can't wait to introduce them to players as the story of Island 3 continues to unfold.

[b]v14.11 Patchnotes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a lot of dead ends that might lock up your progression in the game.
[*] Fixed a list of typos along with some issues where the Player's Custom Name was not showing.
[/list]

If you run into bugs or broken issues, please drop a note in the Community Hub Bug Reporting Section or come over to the Discord Server and drop a line there.

[b]General Thoughts[/b]

It's kind of surreal thinking about how the game has only been out since this Monday. It feels like it's almost been a month. The reception has been great, way better than I expected, and I want to thank each and every one of you who has picked up the game during Early Access. It's already going to make a huge impact on development and has also been the biggest endorsement that I have been working on crafting something cool for people to dig into after a long day.

And we're just getting started!

Have a great weekend.

Wildquill
